overview: Copie Past-e is a retro-cyberpunk cross-listing SaaS on the Internet Computer. It lets sellers create one master listing and prepare platform-specific drafts for Facebook, Mercari, eBay, Poshmark, Depop, and Etsy — then use the companion Chrome extension to autofill each marketplace with one click.
features: NFID authentication with Google Social Login and Internet Identity
Retro-Cyberpunk System Boot initialization screen with mobile bypass
Dynamic 6-platform listing form with full field mapping and character limits
Drag-and-drop image gallery manager for create and edit modes
Smart Gemini OCR that auto-populates the listing form from a photo
Production Chrome extension with window.__COPIE_PASTE_INSTALLED__ detection flag
Full DOM-injection autofill for all 6 marketplaces via INJECT DATA button
Direct extension .zip download for developer-mode sideloading
Zero data loss upgrade hooks for all Motoko state
Cycle watchdog timer with admin notification below 5T cycles
